## Darden Restaurants to Release Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results on December 18, 2026


November 18, 2026


ORLANDO, Fla.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Darden Restaurants, Inc. (NYSE: DRI) plans to release its fiscal 2027 second quarter financial results before the market opens on Friday, December 18, 2026. The Company will host a conference call, led by Rick Cardenas, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Raj Vennam, Chief Financial Officer, to review second quarter results and conduct a question‑and‑answer session on Friday, December 18, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.


The conference call will be webcast and can be accessed through the Company's Investor Relations website at[investor.darden.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825549-1&h=3961128529&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.darden.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investor.darden.com) . Supplementary materials will be available on the website prior to the start of the conference call. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call.


**About Darden** Darden is a full-service restaurant company featuring a portfolio of differentiated brands that include Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, The Capital Grille, Chuy's, Seasons 52, and Eddie V's. For more information, please visit[www.darden.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825549-1&h=2213865329&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.darden.com%2F&a=www.darden.com) .
